decision: Approve these finite design inputs and arithmetic; validate internal broker premises separately. No actual offload output or Phase25 aggregate total is an expectation here.
premises: The source context joins the actual installed Pulsar producer, owning budget and sole gateway writer; the model input persists unchanged through the private source/admission/projection.
Payload means serialized ledger-entry bodies, bounded65536 bytes per future ledger; entry count is bounded1024, and the nonnegative creation-time domain is explicit.

The ordinary data-ledger custom map has the exact3base keys. The current finite ASCII topic-name program bounds the persistence name at67 bytes; strict affinity is false and no namespace affinity group adds placement metadata.
The selected model has one initial ensemble. Another retained ensemble, custom key, topic encoding, negative ctime or unsupported block/format needs a new bound or rejection.
The finite rate/retention inputs and enforced gateway128resident keys per data/index class plus1MiB extent caps are validated independently; a passing output does not select these values.

The rounded quota can dominate larger actual framed extents within1MiB; that capacity dominance does not prove every internal broker assumption or implement a production segment-rate admission protocol.
